evidence: Ov. Ars 3.426: quō minimē crēdās gurgite, piscis erit
terms.comment: As an answer, “not in the least”, “not at all”: Minimē; stronger, Minimē gentium, “not for the world” (Ter.).

evidence: Publil. Syr. N 32: necesse est maximōrum minima esse initia

terms.grammar: noun (neuter of minimus), with a genitive; also an adverb
evidence: Publil. Syr. I 57: quī minimum cupit
Hor. C. 1.11.8: quam minimum crēdula posterō

phrases.latin: quō minimē crēdās gurgite, piscis erit
phrases.english: in the pool where you least expect it, there will be a fish

phrases.latin: is minimō eget mortālis quī minimum cupit
phrases.english: the man who wants least needs least
phrases.source: Publil. Syr. I 57, quoted by Sen. Ep. 108.11

phrases.english: Oh no, not in the least: I won’t do it.

sources: Lewis & Short: parvus (minimus, minimē) · Lewis & Short: minime
